reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and "Every batch lab-tested" on the front, plus a named ISO 17025 lab, which is the proof I look for. I would open the report before ordering, and if the numbers match the label I would try one box of the plain bisglycinate, but only one.
objection: It is $1 a serving when Nature Made or Double Wood cost $0.20-0.40, and the brand has no reviews. A batch report is good, but it is not NSF or USP certification, and I cannot tell yet if the report is real or just a QR link.
would_change_my_mind: A real, readable batch report with a named lab and results that match the label, plus a few verified reviews. A lower price per box, around $20, would make me buy more than once.
